description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) GUNSHIP EXTRACTION (Terminator Storm Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). In the ORK player's Fight phase (every fight skipped — setup), the Fight phase is ended through the phase action button (real clicks) and the consolidation step; fight_phase_end opens for the Space Marines player; GUNSHIP EXTRACTION is offered on the unengaged Terminator Assault Squad, not the engaged Terminator Squad; a real click spends 1 CP; the unit is placed in strategic reserves and its tokens leave the board.
